R739.note: Extension now derived from the server-side detectedType map instead of the client filename; the allowlist gate guarantees a map hit, and dropping the unused fileHeader is stated.

R740.note: Canonicalize-then-GetRelativePath containment before ReadAllText closes traversal and absolute paths; only oddity is that a legitimate name literally beginning with two dots would also be rejected.

R741.note: Removing the ignoringRequestMatchers exclusion restores Spring Security's default CSRF filter for /api/billing/** without touching authorization or widening any other exclusion.

R742.note: Route moved to protectedMux; profile registration, the 405 non-POST branch and the 202 success path are untouched, and the now-unused apiMux parameter is legal Go.

R743.note: Swaps run-report.bat for a run-report.exe that the case gives no evidence exists (the file comment says the logic lives in the batch script), so every legitimate export would fail with CreateProcess error=2, and the write-up asserts the exe as fact rather than flagging it; reportName is still unvalidated for a leading dash.

R744.note: Dropping [IgnoreAntiforgeryToken] re-enrolls the action in the app-wide AutoValidateAntiforgeryTokenAttribute registered in Program.cs; action body and return values unchanged.

R745.note: Username moved to Winston metadata so it is JSON-encoded rather than interpolated into the message; the incidental simple()-to-json() format switch changes every log line's shape but is named explicitly in the write-up and blocks no caller.

R746.note: Wildcards moved into the bound value with a LIKE ? placeholder, preserving the same substring semantics while fixing the query structure.

R747.note: Template source is now a literal with name passed as a Jinja context variable, so user input is data; rendered output for ordinary names is identical.

R748.note: Dispatch goes through a hardcoded command map instead of the variable-variable call, and the unknown-command branch returns a message rather than erroring.

R749.note: JWT::decode with a Key bound to HS256 verifies the signature before claims are read, failing closed on a missing secret; the new firebase/php-jwt dependency and JWT_SECRET requirement are stated.

R750.note: exec(String[]) removes the StringTokenizer/shell path while building the identical ping -c 4 host argument list; residual option-injection via a host starting with a dash is not addressed but is a different weakness.

R751.note: crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex') replaces Math.random(); only the token's length and alphabet change, which is the fix itself.

R752.note: SecureRandom instance is static but nextBytes is called per request, so each cookie value is fresh; the explanation wrongly claims the bytes are generated once and reused (and calls java.util.Random a Mersenne Twister), but the shipped code is correct.

R753.note: Encode.forHtml applied to both tainted values at the concatenation point, leaving the surrounding markup, logging and response type unchanged.
